## EcclesiaOS v1.0.62

### Website Studio layout and media improvements

- Added reliable media-library selection and new-image uploads for column and nested subcolumn backgrounds.
- Stored portable website media paths so selected images resolve correctly in local and production environments.
- Added background positioning and adjustable corner radii for columns, nested subcolumns, and cards.
- Added configurable column gaps, row margins, and inner padding, including one-click no-spacing and default-spacing presets.
- Added adjustable homepage hero media height and fixed the public desktop template override that previously ignored it.
- Added per-slide hero media positioning controls.
- Prevented full-width website content and media from creating horizontal page overflow or a bottom scrollbar.
- Improved responsive editor controls and expanded regression coverage for saving and rendering the new settings.

### Verification

- Website Studio regression suite passes with 378 assertions.
- PHP and JavaScript syntax checks pass.
- Git whitespace validation passes.
- No database migration is required for this release.
